Like
coffee

plain

contains
just

couple
of
calories
per
cup
and
no
sugar
.
But
what's
added
in

change
that
situation
.

medium
sweet
tea
and
a
large
iced
latte
from
fast
food
restaurants
both
pack
about
seven
teaspoons
of
sugar
.

Heart
Association

no
